en: Theragāthā 2.6 Dukanipāta, Paṭhamavagga (First Chapter) [The verses of the Elder Sāriputta] I am one who has crossed over the flood; I have reached the further shore. The Verses of the Elder Meḷajina:
“When I heard the Dhamma as the Teacher was speaking;”
I do not recognize any doubt regarding the All-Knowing, Unconquered One,
the Great Hero, the Charioteer of Men.
In the one most excellent among charioteers,
no doubt exists for me regarding the path or the way of practice.
